question_text:
Consider a non-viscous and incompressible fluid moving with steady streamline flow through a tube of non-uniform cross-sectional area in a vertical plane. Figure shows the streamline flow in a tube. $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ represent three positions of a streamline. Consider the kinetic energies per unit volume ($KE_x$, $KE_y$, $KE_z$), the potential energies per unit volume ($PE_x$, $PE_y$, $PE_z$) and the fluid pressures ($P_x$, $P_y$, $P_z$) at the positions $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ respectively. Of the above inequalities, 
(A) $KE_x > KE_y > KE_z$
(B) $PE_x < PE_y < PE_z$
(C) $P_x > P_y > P_z$

options.option_text: only A and B are true
only B and C are true
only A and C are true
A, B and C are true
